panels.title: Instances
panels.description: Each instance by the node it runs on. Primary: PostgreSQL accepts writes and holds CNPG's primary lease; both must agree. panels.title: Replica lag
panels.description: Largest replay delay of any replica, in seconds. 0 when caught up. Orange over 1 s, red over 15 s. Missing: no instance reports it.

panels.title: Rule checks
panels.description: Role and mapping checks (CNPG custom query). Violations found; missing means the checks stopped reporting.

panels.title: Certificates
panels.description: Days until the first cert-manager certificate expires. Certificates made without cert-manager are not counted. Orange under 14 days, red under 3.

panels.title: Disks
panels.description: The fullest disk of any node. Every disk is listed under Nodes. Orange over 80 %, red over 90 %.

panels.title: Leader and replicas
panels.description: State of each instance over time. Purple is the leader (primary); a purple band moving to another node is a failover or switchover.
